notes: Integrity scan found only 6 soft-hyphen characters (benign). Literature check ran in strict mode (8 of 12 queries); arXiv has almost no SNN-FSCIL work, so the C1 combination could not be checked beyond cited works. 'verify' does not print the abstract, so I read kept_results.jsonl to confirm the Subspace Regularizers abstract. The 'scout' output had no comparable FSCIL numbers, so under-reported baselines could not be checked. The skill says to run 'novelty' on a profile file; I wrote the per-claim profile by hand in the report instead. Ambiguities: (1) DA criterion 4 (fabrication signal) vs a plain reporting error, since identical rows could be copy-paste mistakes; I let the DA raise CRITICAL and the EIC downgrade, with BEFORE run provisionally upheld (resolvable_without_new_data true so the ceiling was 4) and the AFTER run not upheld. (2) The pool-position consistency rule (Overall 4 needs pool >= 65 and mostly >= 60 dimension scores) is tight for a lenient Perspective reviewer; R3 had dimensions at 55-66. (3) The composite cross-check (EIC-weighted 49.1, band 2) disagreed with the rating-based starting point 3 within one point of the band edge; the skill's 'near boundary' rule covered this. (4) The skill requires reviewers' independence but here all five passes shared one context; disclosed in the report. (5) Figure-based checks (Fig. 4-5 bars, Fig. 6, Fig. 8) rely on garbled extracted text and are flagged as unverifiable; E9 was not checked. (6) The venue label for ICLR prints rating 4 on {0,2,...} for an internal Overall 3, which could confuse readers.
